Practice context

The page uses the retained Winter Park office phone, address, map, and displayed hours. Practice confirmation of hours, after-hours routing, and final clinical/legal wording remains required.

Why this page exists

Phone first for urgent dental concerns

This campaign variant keeps the urgent path phone-first and separates office routing from emergency medical care. It does not diagnose, promise same-day treatment, or promise a response time.

Understand the next step

What to know before you contact the team

Who this is for

Visitors looking for urgent dental routing, office contact information, or emergency-care guidance.

What to expect

  • Call the office before relying on an online request for an urgent concern.
  • Use 911 or the nearest emergency department for life-threatening danger or trouble breathing or swallowing.
  • Follow practice instructions rather than using this page as a diagnosis.

Limitations and boundaries

  • The website cannot assess your condition or determine urgency.
  • The page does not promise same-day availability or a response time.
  • The office hours and after-hours pathway must be confirmed before launch.

Questions patients ask

Before you decide

Should I call the office or submit the form?

Call first for an urgent dental concern. The online form is for a routine appointment request and is not connected in this local build.

When should I call 911?

If there is immediate danger or trouble breathing or swallowing, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department.

Does this page diagnose a dental emergency?

No. The website cannot assess your condition.
